answer: Attribution escrow with delayed payout. An identity's rewards route through a tundra of cold-storage escrow for 90 days, and any clone must post the same per-identity escrow to claim a bridge into earning status. Because each new identity locks fresh escrow whose expected value falls below its carrying cost once the shared payout pool is diluted, the marginal clone clears strictly negative. The result is a marble floor on identity count: attackers pay full escrow per clone and recover less than they deposit.
